rawview.help.title: Raw View
rawview.help.intro: Raw View is a read-only monitor of live work in the console. It turns text, states, and activity pace into visual bands so you can see what is moving in real time.
rawview.help.first.title: First steps
rawview.help.first.step1: Identify each session by the dim label at the top of its band.
rawview.help.first.step2: Read hue, shade, texture, and brightness to identify the world, session, provider, and pace.
rawview.help.first.step3: Use each band's text panel and the lower feed to read real fragments.
rawview.help.first.step4: Watch the odometer at the bottom right and service heartbeats at the top right.
rawview.help.first.step5: Close the tab with ✕ or Esc when you finish observing.
rawview.help.legend.title: Legend
rawview.help.legend.console.name: Warm hue
rawview.help.legend.tolkien.name: Green hue
rawview.help.legend.other.name: Cool hue
rawview.help.legend.other.desc: other worlds or a Codex session whose world could not be identified
rawview.help.legend.shade.name: Shade
rawview.help.legend.shade.desc: a stable variation distinguishes each session within the same world
rawview.help.legend.texture.name: Texture
rawview.help.legend.texture.desc: real text reveals the provider: Claude's language or Codex's code
rawview.help.legend.energy.name: Brightness and density
rawview.help.legend.energy.desc: rise with tokens per second; an active band falls faster and brighter
rawview.help.legend.working.name: Working
rawview.help.legend.working.desc: the session is running a turn
rawview.help.legend.delegating.name: Delegating
rawview.help.legend.delegating.desc: waiting for a subagent or process while the band breathes
rawview.help.legend.alive.name: Alive
rawview.help.legend.alive.desc: the session remains open even when it is not working
rawview.help.legend.headless.name: Text without a live session
rawview.help.legend.headless.desc: real text arrived, but there is no associated live chat
rawview.help.legend.dying.name: Dying
rawview.help.legend.dying.desc: the source stopped being alive and its band is dissolving
rawview.help.legend.subagent.name: Subagent
rawview.help.legend.subagent.desc: a narrow band separated from a session's delegated work
rawview.help.legend.terminal.name: Bash terminal
rawview.help.legend.terminal.desc: a green band for a live terminal producing text
rawview.help.legend.job.name: Process
rawview.help.legend.job.desc: an amber band for a deterministic job in progress
rawview.help.legend.health.name: Green heartbeat
rawview.help.legend.warn.name: Amber heartbeat
rawview.help.legend.fail.name: Red heartbeat
rawview.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
rawview.help.buttons.help.v: Opens this guide without changing the observed activity.
rawview.help.buttons.close.v: Attempts to close the tab; it works when the view was opened from the console.
rawview.help.buttons.escape.v: Performs the same action as ✕. If the browser cannot close the tab, close it manually.
rawview.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
rawview.help.warning.text: This is an admin-only view because it shows real text from host sessions, although it cannot edit or run actions. The odometer estimates live flow; it is not billing data. Use the Usage panel for consumption figures.
